stable.body:
• Material 3 Expressive design
• New map list with searching, sorting and grid style options
• Shizuku support
• Full support for scoped storage & folder configuration
• Multi-selection and batch actions for maps
• Show thumbnail of chosen map
• Quickly open/download maps from .zip files and URLs
• Improved UI for wide screens and RTL layouts
• Many visual overhauls & redesigns
• Many bug fixes
• Monochrome icon

### ✨ New Features

### 🐛 Bug Fixes
- [`f98322c`](https://github.com/aliernfrog/pf-tool/commit/f98322cc1f7ea75ead5693615cef0e53b90bfd3f) - **SAF**: Catch errors when checking for URI permissions *(commit by @aliernfrog)*
- [`d1d3cf2`](https://github.com/aliernfrog/pf-tool/commit/d1d3cf2c39df3ac6dc6966a5894eac6ad1cee39a) - Handle DocumentsUI being disabled/uninstalled *(PR #107 by @aliernfrog)*
